articleTitle: Self-Organizing Coalition Formation Based on Non-Cooperative Games in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In multi-agent systems, the individual agent must form coalitions to accomplish complex tasks. However, the centralized management model is not flexible in a dynamic environment. To overcome the restriction caused by central control, the paper presents a self-organizing dynamic coalition mechanism based on game theory. Firstly, we adopt a distributed network to communicate among agents, allowing agents to solve the real-time task assignment problem autonomously. Next, a non-cooperative game negotiation model is introduced to find the optimal strategy for each agent. Finally, the effectiveness of our mechanism is validated by comparing it with the traditional command model in three distributed networks. Experimental results indicate the proposed mechanism is capable to improve the system utility.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Ancient Glass Products Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the process of weathering for a long time, due to the exchange of internal elements and environmental elements, the composition proportion of glass cultural relics changes, which affects the correct judgment of archeological workers on their categories. In this paper, by machine learning method, the random forest algorithm is used to find out the feature attributes with higher importance. Based on the results obtained by random forest, the decision tree algorithm is used to get the decision tree and the classification method of high-potassium glass and lead-barium glass. In addition, the clustering coefficients of high-potassium glass and lead-barium glass were calculated by clustering algorithm, and the number of subclasses of the two kinds of glass was calculated. Then the random forest and decision tree algorithms are used to get the classification methods of high-potassium glass subclass and lead-barium glass subclass.

articleTitle: System Design of Valve Failure Prediction with MySQL
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In view of the lack of management technology and maintenance record-keeping technology for valve testing, based on the two main aspects of feature extraction and fault prediction, consider the actual situation and fully exploit the objective demand for the system from the actual situation, design a data analysis and maintenance management system for valve testing based on MySQL database, and provide a good platform for testing information record, fault prediction and maintenance of nuclear power valves. The system will provide a good platform and foundation for the test information recording, fault prediction and maintenance of nuclear valves, and provide support and reference for nuclear power equipment management and operation and maintenance. The Tkinter toolkit is a very simple and efficient GUI toolkit for the Python environment. It is compatible and portable, and can run on common operating systems such as Windows and Linux. It has become increasingly popular in recent years. This thesis is based on Python Tkinter as a platform for the design and implementation of a data analysis and maintenance management system for valve testing. The main ideas behind this software are: the system manages the valve test data set, stores and analyses the collected data, saves the analysis results in time, runs and visualizes the analysis results on the interactive side, and protects the users who operate the system with encryption. The system is generally easy to operate and has an attractive and clean interface.

articleTitle: Analysis of Anti-Jamming Effectiveness Evaluation of a Communication System in Electromagnetic War
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In electromagnetic warfare and anti-jamming application of a communication system, it is very important to give full play to the anti-jamming efficiency of a communication system in electromagnetic warfare. This paper gives an index system of anti-jamming efficiency analysis based on the related performance of a communication system in electromagnetic warfare, and illustrates the anti-jamming efficiency evaluation method of a communication system in electromagnetic warfare by using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and analytic hierarchy process through examples. The calculation results show that this method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Forestry Text Classification Based on BERT and KNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, the number of various texts on the network is exploding. It is a common demand to classify them. However, in actual production and life, it is often necessary to classify texts in a specific field, such as forestry texts. Use BERT to train the training text, get the text vector of each document, and then average to get the center value of the text vector of each type of document. Based on the idea of KNN, we can judge which kind of text's central vector is closer to each document in the test corpus, so as to achieve the goal of classification. Through experiments, the classification effect of the method based on BERT and KNN idea is better than that of the method using naive Bayes. Using naive Bayes for classification, although the classification effect is not too bad, in order to pursue the accuracy of classification, deep learning models such as the combination of BERT and KNN model are better.

articleTitle: Analysis of Industrial Internet Application Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The development of blockchain technology and its application in the industrial Internet has greatly promoted the transformation of the traditional industrial system to the modern industrial system. At the same time, the integration of blockchain technology and the industrial Internet has further promoted the development of society. This paper introduces the concept and basic technical principles of blockchain technology, proposes that the application of blockchain technology to the current industrial Internet can effectively promote the transformation and upgrading of the industrial Internet system, and summarizes the application of blockchain technology in identification management and collaborative production, supply chain integration, and product manufacturing process tracking. At the same time, it is pointed out that the organic integration of the industrial Internet and the blockchain will also contribute to the evolution of China's industrial system to modernization and intelligence.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Purchase Prediction Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This With the booming development of the Internet, many online trading platforms have emerged, and e-commerce shopping is gradually becoming an important way of consumption for people. While e-commerce brings convenience, it also brings the problem of information overload. Ineffectively selecting products at sea wastes time and reduces the efficiency of product distribution. Therefore, product recommendation has become an important way to alleviate the information overload of e-commerce shopping. In this paper, we formulate the problem as a multi-label prediction task and propose a new graph neural network-based framework, the item-relational graph neural network (IRGNN), for the simultaneous discovery of multiple complex relationships. The feature vectors of nodes are encoded and learned based on known network structures, and the learned node features are decoded to explore the statistical patterns of node features and link formation between nodes, and to analyse which features are prone to form links between nodes that possess them. Extensive experiments have been conducted on real-world product data to verify the effectiveness of IRGNN, particularly on large and sparse product graphs.

articleTitle: Research on Crude Oil Price Forecasting Based on MLR-SVR Decomposition Integrated Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Crude oil prices often show the characteristics of random changes. Mastering the changing trend of international crude oil prices can not only affect China's political stability and economic development but also help investors control the risks of crude oil. In this thesis, a mixed crude oil price prediction model with multiple linear regression (MLR) and support vector regression (SVR) was established by us. The model was applied to predict the international crude oil futures price WTI on the New York Mercantile Exchange and compare the forecast results with the predictions of multiple linear regression and support vector regression. The results show that the proposed hybrid model has high fitting and prediction accuracy, among which, the MAE is 1.12, which is 2.7% and 61.2% higher than that of the single model, respectively.

articleTitle: An Improved Industrial Wireless Network Scheme for Deterministic Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the intelligent upgrading of industrial scenarios, the development of new intelligent manufacturing services has a strong demand for wireless to replace wired. However, the current industrial wireless and cellular networks are still difficult to meet the performance requirements of industrial field networks for deterministic transmission, such as air interface transmission delay, jitter, packet loss rate, synchronization accuracy, and lack of deterministic interoperability and converged communication mechanisms with existing industrial fieldbus, industrial Ethernet, industrial wireless and other heterogeneous networks, making it difficult to meet the requirements of industrial production networks. Therefore, we first propose the development status of the current industrial network and the problems existing in the current industrial wireless technologies, then analyze the development requirements, deployment architecture and key technologies of the improved industrial wireless networks, and finally expound the progress of related industries, hoping to provide reference ideas for the research of new industrial wireless technology for intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Asteroid Mineral Allocation Algorithm for Global Equity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The exploration of space and the struggle for equity are eternal human pursuits. With the vision that humans will be able to mine on asteroids in the near future, it is significant to propose an asteroid mineral allocation strategy that promotes equitable global development. Firstly, the global equity model is proposed to quantify the global equity through 10 indicators of development. The weights of these indicators are calculated by the Entropy Weight Method (EWM). Then, the comprehensive development index of each country is calculated by TOPSIS. By using the Thiel index to evaluate the inequity among countries' comprehensive development index, equity index will be defined. Based on the multiple resource allocation algorithm Dominant Resource Fairness, the DRF algorithm applicable to asteroid mineral resource allocation is proposed by adding the process of classifying countries and resources and assigning different weights to them. In order to verify whether the proposed allocation strategy is effective in improving global equity, a simulation system will be created. By comparing with random allocation, unrestricted allocation and max-min fairness, weighted DRF algorithm is proved to be significantly better than random allocation and unrestricted allocation, and achieves almost the same effect as max-min fairness while reducing the restriction on resource allocation to developed countries. Therefore weighted DRF can significantly improve global equity by proper allocation of asteroid mineral. According to the results simulation system, after 50 years of asteroid mineral resource allocation, the global equity index was able to achieve a decrease in the Thiel index from 0.3 to 0.1.

articleTitle: Insulator Defect Detection and Positioning Method in Power Grid Inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the innovation and development of social economy and science and technology, transmission lines have gradually emerged the characteristics of long distance development, high power, high voltage and so on. However, due to the complex environment, it is very easy to appear aging, natural damage and other problems, which directly affect the safety and stability of power grid system operation. Insulators are one of the most widely used parts in the power grid system. How to accurately locate, detect and analyze the defects of insulators in the power grid inspection is the main problem explored by the power industry at present. Know the inspection in this paper, we study the status quo, on the basis of insulator defect detection technology at home and abroad, according to research results, the deep exploration to the BP neural network as the core of defect classification testing and inspection images for unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) is the core of image processing technique, finally the experimental results show that the two methods can accurately identify the insulator at the same time, Help staff quickly find the location and solution.

articleTitle: Emergency Treatment in Case of Electric Leakage Protection Device Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the era of technological innovation and development, the State grid system has used a large number of new technologies to improve the performance requirements of the system operation. Because the electricity is one of the People's Daily life and work necessary resources, so in the modern society construction innovation, the relevant state departments for relevant safe hidden trouble, strengthen the supervision of power system, research scholars also put forward in practice to explore a variety of protection device, in order to can reduce the unnecessary accidents. Therefore, based on the understanding of the state grid system operation and leakage protection system research status, this paper proposes a portable non-contact leakage detection device for 400V distribution network, and clarifies the specific measures for the state maintenance, operation and maintenance of distribution network equipment in the new era combined with practical cases.

articleTitle: Research on The Development Path of Multinational Enterprise Management Mode Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the information age, people are faced with new problems that the traditional exchange guaranteed by face-to-face trust in the past in the supply chain needs new solutions in today's networked electronic transactions with emerging technologies. In the context of economic globalization, multinational enterprises evolved from small and medium-sized enterprises should develop new strategic responses to deal with the complexities of managing operations separated by the barriers of distance, language, time, and culture. On the basis of studying the developing process of cross-border enterprises, this paper analyzes the problems of electronic transactions, discusses the innovation of cross-border e-commerce business model based on Blockchain technology (BT), builds a BT based enterprise framework system, and provides solutions to the problems of trust, customs supervision, cross-border payment, cross-border logistics and cross-border data flow encountered by enterprises. It elaborates a management mode from operating mechanism for SMEs to engage in international business activities in the new age.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Product Design of Industrial Design Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the innovation and development of modern industrial technology, scholars of various countries have carried out survival exploration based on personalized product design. They have not only built a perfect customized system to provide required services for global customers, but also improved the level of modern industrial technology by using advanced concepts such as artificial intelligence. Genetic algorithm, as the main technology of current scientific research and exploration, will use natural genetic mechanism and natural selection and other biological evolution theory to build a global optimization probability search algorithm, and based on selection, exchange, mutation to compile the control mechanism calculation program, digital simulation of biological evolution process. The application of genetic algorithm to personalized products and services in industrial design is embodied in product modeling, concept design, CAD research and other aspects. Although researchers in various countries have achieved excellent results, there are also many problems in sample selection and function construction. Therefore, based on the understanding of genetic algorithm and modern industrial design, this paper deeply discusses how to change the product customization problem into the expression form of genetic algorithm. The final practice results show that the genetic algorithm as the core of industrial design personalized product design has a positive effect.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of The Effect of Band Hopping Jamming on Frequency Hopping Communication System with Simulink
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Strong anti-search, anti-interception and anti-jamming ability have been found in Frequency hopping communication technology. In order to implement effective jamming in frequency-hopping communication system, many jamming techniques have been developed, the band hopping jamming technology is included. This paper firstly starts with the jamming effect of partial band jamming. Secondly, the bit error rate of frequency hopping communication system with band hopping jamming is deduced. The jamming effect of band hopping jamming on frequency hopping communication is calculated, which proves the effectiveness and superiority of band hopping jamming technology. The simulation model of band hopping jamming is built with SIMULINK platform, and the jamming effect of band hopping jamming is simulated, which verifies the correctness of the theoretical derivation.

articleTitle: Research on Site Planning of Communication Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the high velocity developments of 5G, the telecommunications bandwidth is becoming greater and greater, but the coverage area of base stations is becoming smaller and smaller. Therefore, in order to cover the same area, more base stations are needed, so making the planning and selection of communication network sites increasingly difficult. complex. Aiming at different base station planning problems, this paper solves the planning problem of base station site by establishing path loss model and using genetic algorithm. This paper firstly preprocesses the data visualization. Combined with the constraints in the problem, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the location selection coordinates and the selection of base station types. Finally, using Matlab to solve the result, there are 3326 macro base stations and 217 micro base stations, the total cost is 33477, and the proportion of new base station business volume in the total business reaches 91.77%.

articleTitle: Turbulent Effects on Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Gaussian modulation of quantum coherent states are more adaptable with traditional optical communication equipment and have better compatibility with fiber channel in the spatial continuous variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD). We construct a spatial CVQKD model to analyze the effects of turbulent channel parameters, such as beam spreading, absorption, scattering and drift. The model innovatively introduces the role of the phase difference jitter between local oscillator (LO) and quantum signal light. The findings demonstrate a positive correlation between the excess noise and the transmission distance, turbulence intensity, and the time between the LO and the quantum signal light. The secret key rate decreases with the increase of delay time. The simulation results can provide a reference for the design and optimization of the actual spatial CVQKD system.

articleTitle: Automatic Hospital Inspection System Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: To solve the problem of timely replacement of hospital infusion bottle, first, ResNet and DenseNet were utilized as basic network to detect and locate their positions. Second, transfer learning algorithm was employed for the training. Third, part of the convolutional layers were trained while the front some layers were froze, this could reduce greatly the workload of training without significantly reducing the detection accuracy; Last, Canny algorithm was applied to detect the edge information of the sling, the lever position of the liquid medicine was determined by contrasting adjacent frames of dynamic change of edge data. Reminder mechanism was triggered as the liquid lever reached the given threshold.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Corporate Finance from A Fintech Perspective - Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The development of financial technology is the backbone of promoting innovation in entrepreneurial financing, and in this context, corporate financing strategies have been innovated. In this paper, financial data of listed SMEs in the New Third Board of Hubei Province are used by establishing DEA model analysis. By observing their DEA strong effective results, a total of two enterprises with comprehensive technical efficiency are found to have a comprehensive efficiency of 1, and both of them are entrepreneurial enterprises in the pharmaceutical sector to explore a more optimal solution for corporate financing strategies.

articleTitle: Cloud Storage Ciphertext Search Scheme Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The fast search of cloud storage encrypted documents is a research hotspot of searchable encryption at present. However, with the increase of the amount of data, the retrieval efficiency of the cloud server continues to decrease, and its security is difficult to be guaranteed. In order to improve the security and reliability of data in cloud storage, this paper studies the verification of multi-keyword search and document tamper-proof. A novel multi-keyword verifiable search encryption scheme is proposed, which combines blockchain smart contract, local sensitive hash algorithm, asymmetric encryption algorithm and other technologies to achieve fast search and security verification of cloud storage encrypted data. The experimental results show that the scheme can not only ensure security and query accuracy, but also improve query efficiency.

articleTitle: Construction of a Decentralized Management System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The construction of innovation in all fields, conduct the thorough research to the widely used block chain technology, and combined with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data and other advanced technology innovation, not only showed more technical advantages, such as anonymity, security, decentralized, etc., also solve the problem of data provides a new train of thought for people, gradually get rid of the limitation of traditional centralized. Therefore, this paper takes the current performance management of colleges and universities as an example, mainly using decentralized blockchain technology to build a new management system. On the one hand, P2P network and block chain technology microsystem operation to build a safe and stable environment, on the other hand, the results of college students into the block chain, provide users and data interactive interface, thus with query, modify, upload and other basic functions. The final test results show that the decentralized management system with blockchain technology as the core can not only ensure the safety of the system operation, but also orderly transfer and search related information.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Enterprise Organization Management System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the development of modern society and economy, data mining, as an interdisciplinary information processing technology, plays an important role in enterprise decision making and business information. In the face of increasingly fierce competition in the market environment, enterprises will strengthen the control between the upper and lower levels in the organizational design according to the affiliation relationship between various departments, clarify the main process of practice and development, and then use data mining technology to carry out application innovation. In this paper, on the basis of understanding the research status of enterprise organization system, according to the basic theory and main methods of data mining technology, deeply discuss how to apply data mining technology in enterprise organization management system, and make clear the main direction of future enterprise development.

articleTitle: Design of a Mobile Internet-Based Community Sharing Platform and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In this paper, we design a community sharing platform based on mobile Internet by combining the features of open information and economic sharing in the context of “Internet+”. The platform uses the front and back-end separated architecture, and the APP development adopts the current three mainstream frameworks of Android development “Rxjava + Retrofit + MVP” as the network request framework; the back-end adopts the Spring framework based on Java technology as the underlying architecture. The platform is designed to connect the supply and demand sides, so that the resources can solve people's needs in a more convenient and timely manner, while contributing to the creation of a civilized society.

articleTitle: Construction and Design of Strong Electricity in Building Electrical Engineering Based on Immune Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: With the progress and burgeon of society, the continuous advancement of people's living standards, and the continuous increase of people's living needs, this series of burgeon processes are inseparable from the construction industry. The demand for electric appliances in cities and towns has skyrocketed, so the construction of strong electricity in building electrical engineering has become an indispensable and vital part of the project. Whether the construction technology of strong electricity in electrical engineering is reasonable and whether the meanss and strategies are optimized has a great influence on the quality and level of the entire building electrical engineering. In the construction of building electrical engineering, electrical installation is a key part, and strong electricity construction is the main component of electrical installation engineering. The construction design technology of building electrical engineering not only directly affects the overall quality of electrical engineering, but also relates to people's normal life. The means used in this paper is the immune genetic algorithm, which can change with the change of the object in the optimization process. In addition to the advantages of the traditional genetic algorithm, it also has the immune function, which effectively improves the performance of a single algorithm.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Optimization Design of Electricity Sales Channel Based on Power Marketing Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: The diversified electricity sales mode based on the Internet environment not only puts forward new requirements for the construction and management of electricity sales channels, but also provides data and technical support for practical research. This new operation and management mode meets the needs of social and economic development in the new era. Therefore, in order to comprehensively promote sell electricity channel management service level, this paper takes a certain region in recent years, electric power marketing as the core, the big data in understanding sell electricity channel operation management present situation at home and abroad, on the basis of constructing evaluation system dynamics analysis model, deeply explore sell electricity channels operating conditions and comprehensive evaluation results, to put forward countermeasures.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Approach to Integrate CAE Model and ANSYS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In this paper, the application of ANSYS finite element analysis software in design analysis and the experimental verification of hot-press bending joints are systematically discussed, taking hot-press bending joints as an example. The method is designed in a data-driven manner. Based on the experimental study, a new nodal structural analysis model is proposed in which the nodes are considered as the human-machine interaction part of the structure. The framed handrail connecting the furniture part is replaced with a cantilevered handrail, and its performance is determined experimentally. The results show that the stress concentration regions in the CAE model are the same as those in the physical nodes, and each node's stress and strain states can be accurately predicted. Finally, the CAE model is used for static simulation prediction and the obtained outcomes

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Dam Break Flood in Urban Area Based on TELEMAC-2D Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Dam break flood usually has high and large flood peak, which will bring great threat to the life and property safety of people in the downstream area. Through the numerical simulation method to determine the occurrence of dam failure process, predict the dam after the flood routing process, can provide scientific reference basis for reservoir disaster prevention and mitigation. The results show that under instantaneous dam break, the maximum flood flow and maximum flow rate of downstream dam can reach 4400m<sup>3</sup>/s and 12m/s respectively. In Zhengzhou city, the flood level of sections from Changjiang Road to Longhai Middle Road, Songshan Road to Jinshui Road and Nanyang Road to Er-qi Road was higher than the flood dikes on both sides, and the flood overflowed into Jinshui River, causing damage to some areas on both sides. The analysis results can provide support for the preparation of emergency plans for the dam safety management of Guojiazui Reservoir, and provide reference for urban flood emergency rescue measures.

articleTitle: Study on Reactor Temperature Control of Fuzzy Feedforward Combined with PID
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In order to control the temperature in the reactor more accurately, this paper proposes a multi-point temperature fuzzy feed-forward compensation control method, which combines the fuzzy feed-forward with the PID controller to form a control system and acts on the reactor. The reactor is measured by multi-point temperature measurement and compensated for the temperature difference interference, the fuzzy reasoning is combined with the static feed-forward control, the feed-forward coefficient is regulated in real time, and the temperature of the reactor is accurately controlled by the traditional PID, and the simulation study is carried out by Simulink, and the simulation results show that the control system has a better control effect on the interference.

articleTitle: Research on Prognostic Risk Assessment Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Networks and Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: By integrating multi-omics data and assessing medical risk based on patient-specific genes (cancer prognostic risk assessment), prognostic interventions and personalized treatment can be efficiently provided for patients, thus significantly improving the survival rate. In this paper, we propose AGPP (Attention graph prognosis prediction), a method for assessing medical risk based on multi-omics data. In this paper, genes with robust and biological significance were screened in combination with tumor-related knowledge by statistical test, and carried out bioinformatic analysis combined with biological knowledge. Secondly, Secondly, based on the gene set obtained by bioinformatics analysis, a new tumor prognosis risk assessment method is proposed, which combines graph neural networks and attention mechanisms, realizing the stratification of survival risk. The experiment is trained on the multi-omics data and survival data of pancreatic cancer through ten-fold cross-validation. The results indicate that the method takes the best effect, applicable to divide the survival subtypes of pancreatic cancer.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism and Simulation of Data Sharing in Blockchain Based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: Data sharing plays a vital role in forming a complete blockchain system. This paper focuses on how to incent the enterprises in the blockchain of enterprise alliance to upload offline data to the chain to complete data sharing in the blockchain. To encourage enterprises to actively upload shared data to the blockchain, it is necessary to give reasonable rewards to the enterprises sharing data and punishments to the enterprises not sharing data. This paper builds an incentive model for data sharing of enterprises, and analyzes the evolutionary stable strategies in different conditions using evolutionary game theory. When the evolutionary game reaches a stable state and all enterprises choose to share data, the incentive value in the stable state is a reasonable incentive value. And then, with the automatic execution of smart contract in the blockchain, the incentive mechanism of data sharing can be written into the smart contract. When enterprises upload data, the incentive is automatically triggered to continuously encourage enterprises to upload data. Finally, several evolutionary stable strategies are simulated and verified by using Repast.

articleTitle: Determination of Anti-SARS-CoV-2 Activity of Compounds Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In 2020, the outbreak of pneumonia caused by novel coronavirus spread rapidly all over the world. In the absence of a specific drug, novel coronavirus is still pandemic all over the world. In this paper, we proposed an improved molecular activity prediction model by adding feature selection method on the basis of comparing different methods to extract molecular features and machine learning models. We first used the anti-SARS-CoV-2 compounds reported in recent literatures to construct the data set, and then constructed three machine learning models. In addition, we tried to use three methods to extract molecular features in each model. In order to further improve the performance of the model, we add three feature selection methods. Through the comparison of different models, finally, we used FCFP to extract molecular features and added lasso feature selection method to establish the SVM model. Its test set accuracy is 90.0%, and the AUC value is 0.961, which could well predict the anti-SARS-CoV-2 activity of the compound. Our model can be used to speed up the research and discovery of anti-SARS-CoV-2 drugs.

articleTitle: Introduction to Public-Key Cryptosystems and Hotspot Analysis Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: This paper first introduces the relationship between classical cryptography and public-key cryptography, presents the public-key cryptosystem, draws out the research status and progress of the public-key cryptography system, and introduces the principle, process, and security analysis of the public-key cryptosystems. Then it explains the principle, key generation, encryption, decryption processes, security analysis, and optimization design, including RSA, ECC, ElGamal, Knapsack, and NTRU ciphers, and discusses the progress of each cipher. To understand RSA more deeply, this paper uses python to implement RSA encryption-decryption system, the automatic key generation, and file dragging encryption and decryption functions. Finally, I used CiteSpace to conduct a visual statistical analysis of relevant papers in Web of Science and concluded that the current hot direction of public-key cryptography research is cloud computing and asymmetric public key cryptosystem direction.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Cyber Cyberspace Resilience Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Information Technology, Communication Ecosystem and Management (ITCEM)
abstract: In the face of complex and unknown network attacks, it is impossible to provide comprehensive defense against all attacks. Therefore, Network Resilience will become a necessary design attribute of next-generation heterogeneous networks. Focusing on the research on resilience technology in cyberspace, the basic concepts and typical architectures of cyber resilience are discussed, and the research status and design methods of cyber resilience are discussed in terms of quantitative evaluation and system optimization. The existing research problems are summarized and analyzed, and the future development direction and challenges of elastic technology are prospected.
